narrative.summary: A real, publicly-named 9-of-12 Safe that can bypass the ordinary L2 core Timelock’s 8-day delay in an emergency - the chain’s own systemic root, not a bounded protocol authority.
narrative.detail: A standard, publicly-documented part of Arbitrum’s own security model (an intentional emergency-bypass path, not a discovered flaw), scored on the strength of the Safe itself and the ordinary delay that still applies to the non-emergency path.
